rules: GPIO35-GPIO37 are reserved by octal PSRAM on N16R8 and are not used.
SD uses SPI mode so the display and radios can share one bus.
Camera uses a confirmed 8-bit DVP assignment; camera FPC pin order remains module-specific.
LTE audio stays between the A7670 module and microphone/speaker; it does not consume ESP32 GPIOs.
unresolved: A7670SA module header pinout must be frozen to the exact purchased carrier board.
OV2640 FPC pin order must be frozen to the exact purchased camera module.
Display connector pin order must be frozen to the selected adapter board.
GPIO46/GPIO47 availability must be checked against the exact ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 datasheet revision before layout lock.
